subject: Future Tech
title: Prediction: Reading Road Users
description: One-minute skill: Prediction: Reading Road Users.

hook.text: A pedestrian at a crosswalk glances at their phone. Will they cross?

buildup.text: Prediction models track every moving object and forecast where it'll be in 1, 3, and 5 seconds from now.

discovery.text: It reads cues: a cyclist leaning left will turn, angled wheels signal a lane change, a step off the curb means crossing.

twist.text: Humans are wildly unpredictable. A jogger suddenly reverses. A driver runs a red light.

climax.text: Transformer models now predict multiple possible futures simultaneously, assigning probabilities to each action.

punchline.text: The best driver isn't the fastest. It's the best predictor.

quiz.question: How do AV prediction models handle uncertainty?
options: They stop the car until the path is clear
They predict multiple possible futures with probabilities
They always assume the worst case
